newsitem.title: USA: Translation Group makes second int'l acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Translation Group makes second int'l acquisition.

text.p: The Translation Group Ltd, a provider of document and software translation services, said Thursday it has agreed to acquire Word House, a Netherlands-based translation services company with sales of $3.9 million.
Terms of the acquisition were not disclosed.

The company said this is its second purchase in 30 days. Last month it agreed to acquire World Technology Corp, based in South Korea. The company said the buy was its first strategic move to capture a share of the market for translation services in the Far East.
The transaction is awaiting approval from the South Korean government.
In the interim, the companies have entered into a joint marketing and production venture.
The Translation Group said it is continuing to explore other potential acquisitions which will enable it to service a broader range of international clients.
The Translation Group translates conventional documents and software, specializing in translations of high-tech information in the rapidly growing information technology sector.
